description:

Key job responsibilities

* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns

title: Management Information Systems Manager
description:
**Company Description**
FUTURE VENTURES LIMITED is a United Kingdom–based company headquartered at Brick House, 21 Horse Street, Chipping Sodbury. The organization focuses on building sustainable business ventures with an emphasis on operational efficiency and strategic growth. Team members work in a collaborative environment that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement. The company is expanding its presence and capabilities, creating opportunities for professionals interested in managing information systems and supporting business performance.
  
**Role Description**
The Management Information Systems Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai. This role is responsible for overseeing the design, implementation, and maintenance of MIS processes and tools to support accurate, timely, and actionable reporting for leadership and operational teams. Day-to-day tasks include collecting and validating data from multiple sources, developing dashboards and reports, monitoring system performance, and ensuring data integrity and security. The MIS Manager will collaborate closely with finance, operations, and IT teams to translate business requirements into MIS solutions, optimize workflows, and support planning and forecasting activities. The role also involves troubleshooting system issues, coordinating with vendors or technical teams, and recommending improvements to enhance data visibility and decision-making.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong Analytical Skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and provide insights for decision-making.
* Proficiency in Management Information Systems (MIS), including reporting frameworks, dashboard creation, and process automation.
* Knowledge of Finance concepts to align MIS outputs with financial reporting, budgeting, and performance measurement needs.
* Experience in Information Technology, including familiarity with databases, system administration, and data security practices.
* Hands-on experience with Data Analytics, using tools such as Excel, SQL, BI platforms, or similar technologies.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Finance, or a related field; advanced certification in MIS or analytics is a plus.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and present findings clearly.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain high accuracy in a fast-paced environment.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Team**
The App Components Team is a forward-thinking, platform-focused product engineering team dedicated to crafting the cohesive, high-performing building blocks that define Rippling’s "Enterprise Studio" experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
****Software Engineer I (Backend / Full Stack)****
on this team you will be responsible to build and scale the systems that power these components. While your primary focus will be on the backend, this is a truly full-stack role. You will help design the distributed systems that power our platform and also contribute to React and React Native code to deliver polished end-to-end product experiences.
  
  
You will be responsible for building scalable backend services, APIs, and data models, while partnering closely with product and design to ensure the underlying complexity is translated into seamless, high-performance user experiences.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and implement scalable backend services using Python and Golang to support complex enterprise data modeling and product use cases.
* Contribute to systems that operate at scale, with exposure to distributed systems challenges and technologies such as Kafka, Flink, and AWS.
* While your strength lies in backend engineering, you will also contribute to the frontend codebase. You will write high-quality React and React Native code to ship end-to-end features and help deliver intuitive, performant UI components.
* Take ownership of meaningful product initiatives from early problem definition through implementation. You will help shape technical designs for new "App Studio" capabilities and deliver robust solutions.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, participate in thoughtful code reviews, and contribute to strong engineering standards across backend and frontend systems.
* Work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to break down complex user problems and build components that are technically strong and practically useful for teams building on top of them.

**What You Will Need**

* 1+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience building production systems
* Proficiency in building scalable backend services. Experience with Python, Django, Golang, MongoDB, and AWS is highly preferred.
* Comfortable in writing and shipping production code in React and React Native. You should understand component lifecycles, state management, and mobile constraints well enough to build and iterate on UI for the systems you own.
* Ability to design scalable, reliable systems and reason through trade-offs such as consistency, performance, and fault tolerance.
* Experience building reusable systems, frameworks, or developer-facing components is a plus. You should be excited by building flexible foundations that can support multiple product use cases over time.
* A track record of independently driving projects, navigating ambiguity, and delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

**QA Engineer**

The QA Engineer will lead testing efforts for assigned applications, develop and maintain automated regression suites, and serve as the primary QA partner for business analysts, developers, and stakeholders.

* Analyze business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify risks, gaps, and test scenarios.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, and system testing across multiple applications and releases.

* Design, develop, and maintain automated UI and API test scripts within the team's automation framework.

* Mentor and guide Associate QA Engineers by reviewing test cases, automation scripts, and testing approaches.
